verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs describe API-based batch sends of personalized emails to multiple recipients (up to 1000 versions per request) and scheduling emails for a future time, which approximates a scheduled broadcast through the public API. The evidence never documents a marketing-campaign creation endpoint; the campaign-management claim is framed through AI tools (MCP) rather than a documented REST campaign API. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented campaign create/schedule API endpoint, confirmation that scheduling applies to campaigns rather than only transactional emails, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Send customized emails to multiple recipients in a single request.
Schedule emails to be sent at a specific time in the future.
Send up to 1000 personalized email versions in a single API request
Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
